period_note: Year-end position from the Annual Report 2020's own 'Financial Highlights - The Premier Bank Limited & Consolidated' table, Solo column. Two restatements were found and, per project convention, this year's own contemporaneous figures are kept (not the later ones): (1) Total Assets is reported here as 313,316.22, but the FY2021 report's own 'Five Years Financial Summary' table and the FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 reports' five-year tables all show FY2020 Total Assets as 315,723.19 (a Tk.2,406.97m / 0.77% gap) - Deposits shows the same pattern (241,953.91 here vs 241,630.24 in every later report, a Tk.323.67m gap), while Loans (213,204.68) is identical across all vintages. (2) Total Operating Income/Total Operating Expense are reported here as 13,175.64/6,393.16, but the FY2022 report's own five-year table shows 12,145.29/5,362.80 for FY2020 - both gaps are identical in magnitude (Tk.1,030.35m), so Operating Profit (6,782.48) and everything below it (Provision, PBT, PAT) are unaffected and identical in both vintages; this is a pure gross/net presentation change with no bottom-line impact, not a restatement of profitability. Reserve fund = Equity 20,241.36 minus Paid-up 9,702.98 = 10,538.38, matching the FY2022 report's own 'Reserve and Surplus' line for FY2020. Tier-1 (18,523.27), Tier-2 (10,311.85), Total Capital (28,835.12) sourced from the FY2022 report's five-year capital-strength table; CRAR reproduces to 13.64%, matching this year's own reported figure. NPL% is reported here as 2.58% (this year's own figure, matching the FY2021 report's comparative); the FY2023 report's later five-year table shows a restated 2.51% for FY2020 (denominator basis broadened to include OBU & staff loans from FY2023 onward) - contemporaneous 2.58% kept. FLAG: 2.58% does not reproduce exactly from classified_loans/gross_loans in this JSON (5,357.21/213,204.68=2.51%, a 0.07pp gap) - the contemporaneous reported ratio evidently used a marginally different loans denominator than the plain Balance Sheet 'Loans, advances and lease/investments' figure stored here; both classified_loans (5,357.21) and gross_loans (213,204.68) are independently confirmed as reported. Return on equity (10.62%) reconciles to average equity. Total liabilities calculated as Total Assets minus Total Equity using this year's own contemporaneous Total Assets.
